thread.title: Netflix Breaks Out On 'Bright' Prospects For Film, Overall Business

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Breaks Out On 'Bright' Prospects For Film, Overall Business
text:
Netflix ( NFLX ) shares rocketed for the second straight day on Wednesday, riding positive sentiment from a pair of bullish analyst reports on Tuesday.
X Netflix stock broke out of a 12-week flat base with a buy point of 204.48 in morning trading on Wednesday. That topped its previous all-time high of 204.38, reached on Oct. 17. However, the stock's lagging relative strength line provided a caution flag.
Netflix added 2% to close at 205.05 on the stock market today . Earlier in the session, it notched a record high of 206.21.
On Tuesday, Loop Capital Markets analyst David Miller reiterated his buy rating on Netflix and labeled it his "best idea of 2018." He also raised his price target on the stock to 241 from 237. Meanwhile, Macquarie Research analyst Tim Nollen upgraded Netflix to outperform from neutral and raised his price target to 220 from 200.
Both analysts said Netflix is well-positioned to lead the subscription video-on-demand market, despite threats from Amazon ( AMZN ), Apple ( AAPL ) and Walt Disney ( DIS ). They also said Netflix is likely to show its earnings power in 2018.
